title: On Fast-Slow Mean-Field Forward-Backward Stochastic Systems
summary: We establish an averaging principle for a class of multiscale mean-field forward-backward stochastic differential equations and identify several novel phenomena that are absent from classical fast-slow systems. In contrast with classical fast-slow systems, the effective dynamics cannot in general be obtained by simply freezing deterministic slow parameters and averaging against the invariant measure of the resulting fast equation.
